ArthasMasteryFrostPresenceHowlingBlast.name: Frost Presence
ArthasMasteryFrostPresenceHowlingBlast.description: Quest: Root enemy Heroes with Howling Blast. Reward: After Rooting 5 Heroes, Howling Blast's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Reward: After Rooting 10 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20%. Reward: After Rooting 20 Heroes, Howling Blast also Roots enemies in its path

ArthasMasteryEternalHungerFrostmourneHun.name: Eternal Hunger
ArthasMasteryEternalHungerFrostmourneHun.description: Quest: Use Frostmourne Hungers on an enemy Hero. Reward: Increases the Mana it restores by 4, to a maximum of 40, and its damage by 4.

ArthasRime.name: Rime
ArthasRime.description: Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

ArthasDeathlord.name: Deathlord
ArthasDeathlord.description: Increase the range of Death Coil by 30%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, its Mana cost is refunded.

ArthasMasteryFrozenWastesFrozenTempest.name: Frozen Wastes
ArthasMasteryFrozenWastesFrozenTempest.description: Frozen Tempest Mana cost reduced by 2 per second. Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Frozen Tempest. Reward: After damaging enemy Heroes 150 times with Frozen Tempest, the Movement and Attack Speed Slows of Frozen Tempest last an extra 1.5 seconds against enemy Heroes.

ArthasIcyTalons.name: Icy Talons
ArthasIcyTalons.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 1.5 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, to a maximum of 60%.

ArthasMasteryImmortalCoilDeathCoil.name: Immortal Coil
ArthasMasteryImmortalCoilDeathCoil.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 50% bonus healing.

ArthasRuneTap.name: Rune Tap
ArthasRuneTap.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.

ArthasIceboundFortitude.name: Icebound Fortitude
ArthasIceboundFortitude.description: Activate to gain 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%, and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

ArthasHeroicAbilityArmyoftheDead.name: Army of the Dead
ArthasHeroicAbilityArmyoftheDead.description: Summons Ghouls that last 15 seconds and atttack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Sacrifice Ghouls to heal for 267 (+4% per level) Health.

ArthasHeroicAbilitySummonSindragosa.name: Summon Sindragosa
ArthasHeroicAbilitySummonSindragosa.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

ArthasShatteredArmor.name: Shattered Armor
ArthasShatteredArmor.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

ArthasMasteryBitingColdFrozenTempest.name: Biting Cold
ArthasMasteryBitingColdFrozenTempest.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 12.5% bonus damage, up to a 50% bonus.

ArthasMasteryFrostStrikeFrostmourneHunge.name: Frost Strike
ArthasMasteryFrostStrikeFrostmourneHunge.description: Reduces Frostmourne Hungers' cooldown by 2 seconds. Frostmourne Hungers also Slows the enemy by 50% for 1.5 seconds.

ArthasMasteryEmbraceDeathDeathCoil.name: Embrace Death
ArthasMasteryEmbraceDeathDeathCoil.description: Death Coil deals more damage and heals more the lower Arthas's current Health is, to a maximum of 100% bonus damage and healing.

ArthasMasteryRemorselessWinterFrozenTemp.name: Remorseless Winter
ArthasMasteryRemorselessWinterFrozenTemp.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 3 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds. This effect can only happen once every 10 seconds.

ArthasMasteryFrostmourneFeedsFrostmourne.name: Frostmourne Feeds
ArthasMasteryFrostmourneFeedsFrostmourne.description: Increases the amount of Basic Attacks empowered by Frostmourne Hungers to 2.

ArthasMasteryLegionOfNorthrendArmyoftheD.name: Legion of Northrend
ArthasMasteryLegionOfNorthrendArmyoftheD.description: 3 additional Ghouls are created. Ghouls deal 50% more damage, heal for an additional 50%, and last 5 seconds longer.

ArthasMasteryAbsoluteZeroSummonSindragos.name: Absolute Zero
ArthasMasteryAbsoluteZeroSummonSindragos.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

ArthasDeathsAdvance.name: Death's Advance
ArthasDeathsAdvance.description: Increases Movement Speed by 10%. Frozen Tempest's maximum Movement Speed Slow and Attack Speed Slow increased from 40% to 60%

ArthasAntiMagicShell.name: Anti-Magic Shell
ArthasAntiMagicShell.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.
